title: WOLFHSM=1 build missing required compile flags
description: When WOLFHSM=1 is passed to make, the Makefile adds -I$(WOLFHSM_DIR) and -DWOLFP11_CFG_WOLFHSM_BACKEND but is missing flags required for wolfHSM headers to compile: (1) -DWOLFHSM_CFG_ENABLE_CLIENT guards all client API in wh_client_crypto.c — without it, wh_Client_EccSign etc. are not compiled, link fails with undefined references. (2) -DHAVE_ANONYMOUS_INLINE_AGGREGATES=1 required by wolfSSL, asserted in wh_settings.h:386. (3) -DWOLFHSM_CFG_PORT_GETTIME=<fn> asserted in wh_settings.h:181. The syntax check only passed because these were added manually.
